newsitem.title: USA: Horejsi group lifts Preferred Income stake.
newsitem.headline: Horejsi group lifts Preferred Income stake.

text.p: A group including Horejsi Enteprises Inc said Monday it raised its stake in Preferred Income Management Fund Inc to 20.08 percent or 1,891,100 common shres.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 146,800 additional shares of Preferred Income between November 22 and December 6 at prices ranging from $14.50 to $14.625 a share.

The group previously held an 18.52 percent stake or 1,744,3200 common shares in Preferred Income, a Pasadena, Calif.,-based closed-end mutual fund concern. Closed-end funds have a limited number of shares.
